notes: Systems referenced by techs.json effects. Names here are working names; lore pass comes later.

tierPower.note: Multiplier for each arms/guard tier step. TierPow(t) = product of steps 1..t.

tierGate.note: To draw a non-spine tech of tier t in branch b, the civ must know min(need, count) techs of tier t-1 in b.

research.spineNote: Spine techs (the original 38) are weighted x spineBias and the lowest-tier available one is always dealt into its area's hand, so the old milestones keep their pace.
research.nonSpineTierNote: Extra cost multiplier for non-spine techs by tier, on top of costScaleNonSpine, so the exotic tiers stay rare (T8+ for only a few civs).

Umbral.note: Dark matter. res:X+n adds n x 0.01 per year per colony, scaled by colony capture (min 0.1).

Abyssal.note: Dark energy. Reservoir (UMB-6) raises the cap; overflow adds Breach.

Stellarine.note: Star essence. Stockpile above cap adds Flux and can spawn a Star-Wyrm.

Lumen.note: Static light. Only from gate trials, gifts, or LUX/MIN-14.

pools.upkeep: Each known tech with use:Pool drains 0.002 per year per colony. While a pool is empty, effects of techs that use it are skipped in ComputeMods (arms/guard tiers fall back to the best tier that is still fed).

GE6.name: Umbral Breakthrough
GE6.trigger: civ knows UMB-1 and at least 4 tier-5 techs

keys.what: special project: 40 x TierCost[6] x costScaleNonSpine research, paid from the Physics slot
win 3 battles against a civ that knows UMB-3
relations >= +50 with a civ that knows UMB-3; they choose Charity/Gift/Teach/Refuse/Insult/Trade by ethic
pay an ancient civ 2 x stock fraction; starts the project at 75%

GE6.consequence: meter Elders +5 on every ancient civ that has met them

GE7.name: Abyssal Drawing
GE7.consequence: ancient civs demand a sample: if refused, relations -40 and war if below -60 (meter Elders)

keys.what: the Visitor encounter ended in Talk or Study
pay stock; roll 45% success / 45% fail / 10% fail and devastate the colony

GE8.name: The Vault
GE8.galaxyContent: one Vault system flagged at galaxy creation (StarInfo.Special = "vault"), guarded

keys.what: win a battle against a civ that knows GLY-1
relations >= +40 with the vault holder (if one exists)
ARC-9 raids on the Vault system, 4 stages; each stage grants one more GLY tech

GE9.name: Rekindled Star
GE9.trigger: civ knows GLY-2 and (ARC-7 or CHR-5)
GE9.galaxyContent: one dormant Shard star flagged at galaxy creation (StarInfo.Special = "shard"); it reignites when the first civ triggers GE9

keys.what: a colony within 60 units of the Shard, or the Archive Uplink

GE10.name: Sealed Gates
GE10.galaxyContent: 4 Gate systems on the galaxy rim (StarInfo.Special = "gate"), guarded and hidden until perceived (see perception); seals weaken from year 2600 (tunable)

keys.what: reach a Gate and pass trial 1 (battle vs guardian, or riddle choice made by council ethic)
pass trials 2 and 3; wrong riddle answers still grant a minor tech and allow a retry

AI.note: reuse existing digital secession crisis; machines break away as a splinter civ

Mind.note: new: a transapient mind takes the council for a decade

Strange.note: new: a world converts to strange matter

Breach.note: new: hostile fleet appears at the colony (reuse Rival fleet mechanics)

Veil.note: new: council possessed; drive flips at random

Atrocity.note: every met civ relations -2 per point; at threshold ancients or divine civs declare war

Elders.note: ancient civs demand tribute, then war

Flux.note: reuse stellar storms; above 80 spawn a Star-Wyrm (roaming hostile)

Egress.note: galaxy-wide: every civ loses some capture when a civ leaves the universe

decompressor.blurb: A drill sunk into a black hole's ergosphere

launchloop.blurb: A magnetic loop that throws cargo to orbit

aegis.blurb: A shield around a whole system

birch.blurb: Nested shells around a black hole

penrose.blurb: A sphere around a black hole

suncitadel.blurb: A citadel drawing on the star

civActs.note: Unlocked by act: effects. Councils consider them in Colony.Decide(). Each reuses the god-power implementation with the civ as the actor, so the chronicle and ripples work the same way.

ethicGate.allowedFor: Ruthless (Pragmatic only at war and losing)

apotheosis.scoreFrom: sum of apotheosis:+n on known techs
apotheosis.chance: 0.004 x score x luck, capped at 0.25 per roll

onFailAtHighScore.result: Fallen: vigour x0.3, research x0.5, stops seeding (like the Vessh)

apotheosis.note: Civs can come close to godhood but never reach it. The voice is the only true god; an Exalted civ is a lesser power with hard limits.

exaltedCiv.keeps: its colonies, which become sacred worlds; economy continues at a slow pace
exaltedCiv.gains: autonomous lesser acts on a 15-40 year rhythm, chosen by drive and ethic: seed_life, ignite, shift_orbit, uplift natives, gift a tech it knows to a favoured civ, smite a hated civ's swarm

limits.reach: acts only inside its own territory plus 40 units
limits.understanding: can only gift techs it knows, and can only create what its own research covers (e.g. kindle_star needs TER-11); the rule dropped for the voice applies to them
limits.strain: each act adds 5 to a Strain value that decays 1/yr; above 40 the civ risks Falling (see onFailAtHighScore result)
limits.cap: Exalted power never exceeds 'nearly': no act a civ can take is irreversible by the voice

exaltedCiv.toTheVoice: relations with the player as a pseudo-civ; if the player harms them they may answer in kind against the player's favoured civs, never against the voice itself
exaltedCiv.visual: gold glow on its territory and hulls

godActs.note: The player is unlimited: no Will, no cost, no cooldown. Faith and Dread remain as witnessed consequences only.

new.GiftTech: Give any tech (including exotic and gate-locked) to any civ. Ripple: exotic gifts add Elders on ancients; others who notice get jealous (relations).
new.EraseTech: Remove a tech from one civ, or from every civ (Erase Concept). Ripple: confusion events; Dread.
new.KindleStar: Create a sim star in empty space or from a nebula.
new.SnuffStar: Put a star out. Anyone there is gone. Horror.
new.MoveStar: Move a star and its system across the galaxy.
new.ForgeWorld: Add a planet to a system, chosen kind and orbit.
new.UpliftNow: Raise a native world straight to spacefaring: it becomes a new young civ.
new.SeedSpecies: Place a brand-new civ on any world.
new.BendFate: Choose the outcome of the current crisis or event.
new.Possess: Speak through the Speaker: force a council decision or research choice.
new.OpenLane: Create a permanent gate between any two stars.
new.Quarantine: Seal a region: no seed ships in or out.
new.RaiseDivine: Lift a civ to Exalted now (still never a true god).
new.CastDown: Strip an Exalted civ back to mortal, or make it Fallen.
new.RewriteLaw: Toggle a global rule (no war, research x2, fold impossible, ...).
new.RaiseAny: Build: raise any megastructure in the catalogue, including the new great works.
new.Steer: See each civ's research hand in every slot. Swap a card, redraw the hand, pin a tech so it comes up next, ban a tech for N years, or decide an exclusive choice (FTL doctrine, Abyssal vs Chrono, ascension path, siphon, mandate) before the council does. Ripple: small Faith; banning or overriding the council adds Dread.

deferred.TimeTurn: Rewind a colony N years: needs snapshotting.
deferred.Genesis: Create a pocket galaxy: needs a second galaxy instance.

perception.note: Special systems exist from galaxy creation but are hidden until perceived. Civs perceive them by advancement; the galaxy view keeps them hidden from the player until the first civ perceives one, so the reveal is a cinematic moment (toggle: showHiddenToVoice, default false).

gate.what: chronicle: something at the rim bends the halo maps; no location
the Gate systems appear for this civ; first civ to reach this triggers the reveal cinematic

shard.what: the dormant Shard appears as a dead star; it rekindles at GE9
